fusions.name: Levelling Drop
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 40 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattening Sweep
fusions.desc: Whips strands round you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hammered Felt
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Points
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
